admission:
Admission procedure: 1) Register on the college admission portal. 2) Fill the online application form and upload marksheets, ID proof and photo. 3) Pay the application fee. 4) Appear for the entrance exam / counselling round. 5) Verify documents and pay the first-semester fee to confirm your seat.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
courses:
Departments and programmes: B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Mechanical and Civil Engineering; M.Tech in CSE and VLSI; MBA; MCA; B.Sc. Computer Science.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
fees:
Annual fee structure: B.Tech Rs. 85,000; M.Tech Rs. 60,000; MBA Rs. 95,000; MCA Rs. 70,000. Fees are payable in two instalments (online / DD). Hostel and exam fees are charged separately.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
eligibility:
Eligibility: B.Tech - 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and at least 50% marks plus a valid entrance score. M.Tech - B.E./B.Tech with 55% and valid GATE/PGCET score. MBA - any graduation with 50% and a valid MAT/CAT/state-level score. MCA - graduation with Maths at 10+2 or graduation level.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
internships:
Internships: students complete a mandatory 6-8 week internship after the 6th semester. The Training & Placement Cell connects students with partner companies, and a certificate plus internship report are required for credit.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
placements:
Placements: the Training & Placement Cell runs aptitude training, mock interviews and campus drives from the 6th semester. Recent sample statistics: 85% placement rate, average package Rs. 5.2 LPA, highest package Rs. 18 LPA, 60+ visiting recruiters.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
scholarships:
Scholarships: merit scholarship (top 10% rankers, up to 50% fee waiver), government post-matric scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students, minority scholarship, and a need-based fee concession. Apply through the scholarship section of the portal with income and caste certificates.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
academic_calendar:
Academic calendar: odd semester runs July-November, even semester January-May. Internal assessments occur mid-semester, end-semester exams in December and May, and vacations in June and late December. The detailed calendar is on the notice board and website.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
examinations:
Examinations: each semester has two internal tests (30 marks) and one end-semester exam (70 marks). A minimum of 75% attendance is required to sit the exams. Hall tickets are issued 7 days before the exam, and results are published about 30 days after the exams.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
hostel:
Hostel: separate boys' and girls' hostels with Wi-Fi, mess, laundry, 24x7 security and a study room. Rooms are allotted on a first-come basis after admission. Annual hostel fee (sample): Rs. 60,000 including mess.

(Sample information - please confirm with the college office.)
library:
Library: open Monday-Saturday, 8:30 AM - 6:00 PM. It holds 40,000+ books, journals, e-resources (IEEE, NPTEL), a digital section and reading halls. Students can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days using their ID card.
